## `neuro.iterator.take`

Instance method on `Iterator.prototype`.

> Creates an iterator whose values are the values from this iterator, stopping once the provided limit is reached.

## Signatures

```ts
take(input: { iterator: <receiver>; limit: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<IteratorObject<T, undefined, unknown>>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Iterator.prototype.take` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
